subject.title: fix(gateway): hide stream-error sentinel from chat history

question: Should gateway chat history hide a provenanced stream-error sentinel once later visible assistant content exists in the same user turn, while preserving standalone failed turns as a generic safe failure row?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and tested, but it changes which assistant display row users receive in chat.history and live session-history SSE, so automation should not decide the product/message-delivery contract alone.

options.title: Accept repaired-turn suppression
options.body: Land this PR because it keeps persistence and standalone failures intact while removing only the misleading repaired sentinel from display.

options.title: Require a stricter display rule
options.body: Ask for an additional guard or test if maintainers want the sentinel to remain visible in more repaired-turn edge cases.

options.title: Pause for broader history semantics
options.body: Keep the PR open while owners decide a larger policy for failed-turn and repaired-turn history display.

recommendation.title: Accept repaired-turn suppression
recommendation.body: Land this PR because it keeps persistence and standalone failures intact while removing only the misleading repaired sentinel from display.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned on this PR and reviewed/co-authored the merged baseline this change refines.
